_readme: Teyvat Chronicle timeline. Edit freely: reorder, delete, add events, change any number or text.
delay = in-game years after the PREVIOUS event, per pacing preset (lore / normal / fast).
The Custom preset uses 'normal' multiplied by the 'Custom time scale' setting.
Effect types: age, grant_trait, grant_set, remove_trait, war, meteor, earthquake, destroy_city,
mark_kingdom, kingdom_traits, disaster, gather_gnosis, spawn_unit. See CHRONICLE.md for every field.

events.title: The Seven Sovereigns
events.banner: THE OLD WORLD — Seven Dragon Sovereigns rule Teyvat
events.text: Teyvat belongs to the dragons. Seven Sovereigns, each holding one elemental Authority, divide the land between them. Their king is Nibelung.

events.title: The Primordial Sea
events.banner: Life rises from the Primordial Sea
events.text: The Primordial Sea lies open on the surface of the world. The Hydro Sovereign is its beating heart, and almost every living thing in Teyvat can trace its origin back to these waters.

events.title: The Three Moons Rise
events.banner: Nibelung raises the Three Moons
events.text: Nibelung lifts three moons into the sky and gives three Moon Goddesses charge of the world's laws. Then the Dragon King leaves Teyvat to travel the stars.

events.title: The Voyager's Warning
events.banner: A voyager from the stars warns of the end
events.text: Anacharsis, a voyager from the sea of stars, finds Nibelung and warns him that this world will be destroyed. He will not abandon his people. The dragons begin reaching for the stars.

events.title: The Heavenly Principles Descend
events.banner: ⚠ THE HEAVENLY PRINCIPLES DESCEND
events.text: An outsider comes down from beyond the sky while the Dragon King is away. It takes the Sovereigns' Authorities for itself and splits four Shades from its own light: Naberius (Life), Ronova (Death), Istaroth (Time) and Asmoday (Space).

events.title: The False Sky
events.banner: The Lunar Veil falls; a False Sky closes over Teyvat
events.text: The dragons' Lunar Veil is torn apart before it is finished. The heavens wrap Teyvat in a False Sky and cut it off from the rest of the universe.

events.title: The Sovereigns Fall
events.banner: After forty years of war, the Sovereigns are defeated
events.text: Forty years after the descent, the Heavenly Principles and their Shades stand victorious. The Sovereigns' subjects flee into the oceans, and the heavens start building a world for humanity.

events.title: The Ark's Opening
events.banner: Humanity is born — the Year of Jubilee begins
events.text: Four hundred years after the descent, the world is ready. Humanity makes a covenant with the heavens. Divine envoys walk among people, and the land flourishes.

events.title: The Ancient Kingdoms
events.banner: Arcadia, Sal Vindagnyr, Lang-Gan, Ys and Hyperborea flourish
events.text: One civilisation spans the world: Arcadia in Mondstadt's oak forests, Sal Vindagnyr on Dragonspine, Lang-Gan in the Chasm, Ys in the desert, Hyperborea in the far north, and Enkanomiya.

events.title: The Pride of Humanity
events.banner: Humanity reaches for the heavens
events.text: People grow proud and ambitious and challenge the gods. They want to rule the heavens and their own fates. Celestia's envoys go silent.

events.title: Nibelung Returns
events.banner: ⚠ THE WAR OF FUNERARY FLAME — Nibelung returns with the Abyss
events.text: The Dragon King comes home to a world taken from him. Armed with the power of the Abyss, he wages war on the heavens. He turns even the moons into weapons.

events.title: The Moons Shatter
events.banner: The Eternal and Iridescent Moons are shattered
events.text: The heavens break the Eternal Moon and the Iridescent Moon and fling the Frost Moon out past the False Sky. The Three Moon Goddesses die, and great floods sweep the land.

events.title: The Celestial Nails
events.banner: ⚠ CELESTIAL NAILS FALL FROM THE SKY
events.text: To purge the Abyss, the heavens drive Nails into the world. Sal Vindagnyr is buried in snow, Lang-Gan and Tsurumi are wiped out, Hyperborea is destroyed, and Sumeru's rainforest turns into the Great Red Sand.

events.title: The Forbidden History
events.banner: History before the war is forbidden
events.text: The heavens ban all knowledge of the age before the war. The Angels are cursed and wither into Seelies, wandering in search of their old courts.

events.title: Khaenri'ah is Founded
events.banner: {khaenriah} is founded — a nation without a god
events.text: Around the time Sal Vindagnyr falls, a nation is founded far below the earth that worships no god at all: Khaenri'ah.

events.title: Seven Thrones Open
events.banner: ⚠ THE ARCHON WAR BEGINS — Seven thrones await in Celestia
events.text: Seven divine seats open in Celestia. Gods, Demon Gods and monsters fall on one another, each fighting for its own dream of humanity.

events.title: The Fall of the Guili Assembly
events.banner: Guizhong falls; Morax founds Liyue Harbor
events.text: A battle tears the Guili Assembly apart and Guizhong, the Lord of Dust, is killed. Morax leads the survivors south with the Adepti and founds Liyue Harbor.

events.title: The Third Descender
events.banner: ⚠ A gate to the Abyss opens; the seven Gnoses are born
events.text: The Belyi Tsar persuades Anastasya and the Third Descender to open a gate to the Shadow Realm, and the Abyss seeps into the world. The Third Descender gives his life. His remains become the seven Gnoses, sealed by a curse that will fall on Celestia if the deal is ever broken.

events.title: The Fall of Decarabian
events.banner: Barbatos overthrows Decarabian, the God of Storms
events.text: Decarabian's people rise against his tower of storms, led by a nameless bard and a wind spirit. The spirit, Barbatos, blows away the ice and reshapes Mondstadt.

events.title: King Deshret's Fall
events.banner: King Deshret falls to forbidden knowledge
events.text: The God-King of the desert is poisoned by forbidden knowledge. His empire breaks up into human city-states, and Rukkhadevata brings the rainforest back.

events.title: Xbalanque Slays Xiuhcoatl
events.banner: The Pyro Sovereign falls; Natlan gains its first Archon
events.text: Xbalanque's army storms the Sacred City of Tollan and kills Xiuhcoatl, the Pyro Dragon Sovereign. The dragon kingdom of Natlantea ends and Xbalanque becomes the first Pyro Archon.

events.title: The Seven Are Crowned
events.banner: ⚠ THE ARCHON WAR ENDS — The Seven take their thrones
events.text: The last seat in Celestia is claimed. Seven Archons, one for each element, now hold a Gnosis. Defeated gods who refuse their rule flee to the islands of the Dark Sea.

events.title: The Gods' Gaze
events.banner: Visions begin to answer mortal wishes
events.text: With the Seven on their thrones, the gods' gaze falls on mortals with strong wishes, and Visions start to appear.

events.title: Dynasties of Khaenri'ah
events.banner: {khaenriah}: the Crimson Moon falls, the Eclipse Dynasty rises
events.text: The Crimson Moon Dynasty rules Khaenri'ah until a coup puts the Eclipse Dynasty in its place. Khaenri'ah's engineers build Ruin Machines to stand against Celestia.

events.title: Vennessa's Rebellion
events.banner: Mondstadt rises against its aristocrats
events.text: Barbatos wakes to the cries of the oppressed. Vennessa leads the rebellion that ends the age of aristocrats and founds the Knights of Favonius.

events.title: Thrones Change Hands
events.banner: Many of the original Seven pass away
events.text: Over fifteen centuries, the first Cryo, Dendro, Electro, Hydro and Pyro Archons all die or step down, and their Gnoses pass to successors. Only Barbatos and Morax remain of the original Seven.

events.title: The Abyss Invades
events.banner: ⚠ THE CATACLYSM — Monsters of the Abyss pour into Teyvat
events.text: Monsters from the Abyss burst out across Teyvat, led by the Alfisol creations of Rhinedottir, called Gold. Nod-Krai and Natlan fall first. The Knights of Favonius march on Khaenri'ah.

events.title: Khaenri'ah Falls
events.banner: ⚠ {khaenriah} IS DESTROYED BY THE GODS
events.text: The Heavenly Principles destroy Khaenri'ah. Ronova curses its people: those of mixed blood turn into Hilichurls, and the pure-blooded are cursed with immortality.

events.title: The Fallen Archons
events.banner: Makoto and Egeria fall in the Cataclysm
events.text: The Electro Archon Makoto goes to Khaenri'ah alone and is killed there. Egeria, the Hydro Archon, falls at Tunigi Hollow. Ei takes her sister's place and Focalors takes Egeria's.

events.title: The Curse Takes Hold
events.banner: ⚠ The Third Descender's curse falls — Celestia sleeps
events.text: Destroying Khaenri'ah breaks the old deal. The Third Descender's curse takes effect and Celestia falls dormant. In that moment Asmoday seals away two travelling twins, and one of them sleeps for five hundred years.

events.title: The Age of Hilichurls
events.banner: Hilichurls spread across the land
events.text: The Khaenri'ahns who became Hilichurls scatter into the wilds and slowly forget who they once were.

events.title: The Fatui Are Founded
events.banner: Pierro and the Tsaritsa found the Fatui
events.text: Pierro, a Khaenri'ahn sage bitter at how the world works, swears loyalty to the Cryo Archon. Together they found the Fatui and its Eleven Harbingers, with Delusions for their soldiers.

events.title: The Abyss Order
events.banner: The Abyss Order rises against Celestia
events.text: Chlothar Alberich founds the Abyss Order to take revenge on Celestia and the Seven. A century later, the Traveler's sibling takes command of it.

events.title: The Traveler Awakens
events.banner: ★ The Traveler awakens
events.text: After five hundred years asleep, a traveler from another world wakes up. With Paimon at their side, they set out across the seven nations to find their lost sibling.

events.title: Song of the Dragon and Freedom
events.banner: Mondstadt: Stormterror is freed; the Anemo Gnosis is taken
events.text: The Traveler frees Dvalin from the Abyss's corruption. Then La Signora of the Fatui takes the Anemo Gnosis from Barbatos in the middle of the street.

events.title: Farewell, Archaic Lord
events.banner: Liyue: Osial rises; Rex Lapis gives up his Gnosis
events.text: Morax stages his own death to test whether Liyue can stand without him. The ancient god Osial rises from the sea. Afterwards Zhongli hands the Geo Gnosis to the Fatui as agreed.

events.title: Omnipresence Over Mortals
events.banner: Inazuma: the Vision Hunt Decree ends
events.text: The Raiden Shogun's Vision Hunt Decree ends after the Traveler challenges Eternity. The Electro Gnosis ends up with Scaramouche.

events.title: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
events.banner: Sumeru: the Lesser Lord is freed; Dottore takes the Dendro Gnosis
events.text: The Sages try to build a new god. The Traveler frees Nahida, who gives up the Dendro Gnosis in exchange for Dottore erasing his segments.

events.title: The Prophecy of Fontaine
events.banner: Fontaine: the prophecy comes due; Focalors passes judgement
events.text: For five hundred years Furina plays the Archon while Focalors waits in secret. When the flood of the prophecy arrives, Focalors condemns herself and destroys the Hydro throne, giving its power back to the Hydro Sovereign.

events.title: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection
events.banner: Natlan: the war on the Abyss; Mavuika burns the Night Kingdom
events.text: Mavuika gathers the tribes' heroes for the last war against the Abyss. With Capitano's help she drives back the Night Kingdom, then gives the Pyro Gnosis to the Tsaritsa.

events.title: The True Moon
events.banner: ★ Nod-Krai: Columbina rises as the Trilune Goddess
events.text: In the moonlit borderlands of Nod-Krai, Columbina meets the remnants of the three Moon sisters and inherits all of their power: the Trilunar Authority. Dottore's plans come to nothing.

events.title: Everwinter Without Mercy
events.banner: ❄ SNEZHNAYA — The Traveler enters the Everwinter
events.text: The Traveler crosses into Snezhnaya, the Cryo Archon's realm, where Pierro, the Jester, is waiting.

events.title: The Curse of Death
events.banner: ⚠ Ronova lays a Curse of Death on Snezhnaya
events.text: Ronova, the Ruler of Death, kills in secret, and Rhinedottir, who now holds the Life Authority, brings the dead back before Celestia can notice. Snezhnaya lives under a Curse of Death.

events.title: A Rekviem for the Underworld
events.banner: ★ The Tsaritsa stops time; Ronova's Authority is taken back
events.text: The Tsaritsa traps Rhinedottir in slowed time with six Gnoses. The Traveler and Dainsleif fight Ronova, and Pierro pays dearly to wield the Eye of the Fatui. Celestia takes back the Death Authority, and Ronova disappears.

events.title: The Holy Soil Spreads
events.banner: ⚠ The Celestial Nails falter — Holy Soil spreads across Teyvat
events.text: Ronova fused EITR into Snezhnaya's Nail of Retribution. Now the Nails all over Teyvat are failing, and Holy Soil, the dragons' Light-Realm land, is spreading. The story continues…
